title: 粗码：为什么越省力分得越粗，而核实为何总是追不上 / Coarse Codes: How Saving Effort Reshapes Resolution, and Why Verification Trails Behind
description:
中文摘要。同一份力气，花在两个地方，会得到两种完全不同的结果。时间紧、睡得少、后果重的时候，人不是变懒了，而是把有限的码率换了一种花法：环境宽的时候缩支撑，只剩一条隧道；环境窄的时候缩刻度，糊成一片。这本书从一条驻点式开始——在加权失真与码率成本之间求极小，得 v*=(T+λ)/(2w)——把它推到个人、群体、社会、文明四层。四层不是一条阶梯，而是一张有环的图：上行把慢量当参数送进快层（涌现），下行只在阈值处改写慢层的可行集（重置）。八部分三十八章，从一张饭桌上的弃养争吵讲起，到“这本书在哪里停”收束。它有推导，也有能复算的读数：两万一千余条核实记录、四十五部分期方案、十八对语言版本的叙事距离、十二万四千余条义项清单、三百九十八个古政体的公开编码、一百二十五个国家的历法采纳年份、一百三十三个人的一次梯度测量。所有数字标 A/B/C 等级；结论强度不超过证据强度。

核心主张。一条规则＝状态空间上的一次划分；理解＝估计这个划分；在“错了有多疼”与“分细要多少钱”之间取驻点，就得到分辨率。由这一条可推：覆盖面翻倍、精度减半（δ=Δ/2^R）；把切点的描述费写进总账，就得两条标度律（赌注抬十倍，类别数涨 √10 或 ∛10）；换码要付一次成本，于是去程与回程不对称（带宽＝2C）。全书只有两原理＋一动力学＋一边界：原理一是预算下的划分极小化；原理二是账可外置、权重可为负；动力学是复制子—变异—保留＋生态构建（§A.12）；边界是外生冲击只经接触面、时刻不可预测（§A.11）。P1—P6 只是六个检索标签，读成两条原理＋四个接触面——价格、切法、群体、账。哪一条结论靠哪一条、额外用了什么假设，见附录 A 的推导地图（表 A.1）。

结构。八部分三十八章：一 舞台（1—3）五个人为什么会在同一张桌上吵；二 个人（4—8）码围着什么建；三 两笔预算（9—12）爱与好奇要付什么码率；四 群体（13—17）为什么两个人必须用同一套切法；五 演化（18—22）变异、选择、场域如何改写可行集；六 社会（23—28）核实、账单、内卷、漂移与临界能测到什么；七 文明（29—34）转型、分期、翻译与边缘如何换码；八 边界（35—38）这本书在哪里停。六核心（看见、记住、跟上、选择、讲述、临界）各占一章，各有专属装置。附录 A 形式化与证明、B 数据与复现（含十二个读数的文件、字节与哈希）、C 协议与稳健性、D 可证伪登记簿（append-only，16 行）、E 工具与清单、F 否证线总表（18 条在表、20 条在正文）。

故事轨。全书有一条并置式的故事轨：弗朗提努斯、默里、巴纳姆、塞麦尔维斯、柴门霍夫五个人，不生活在同一个年代，却坐在同一张长桌前谈一台被删掉的机器。人、事、话都有出处，那场见面是虚构的（《故事新编》式）。人物页给出五个人、五个位置、五组价格，并把五条线接成同一条流水线上的五个卡点：量→切与溯源→记→核→属；第 1 章把这场争吵拆开，第 2 章把它压成一条原理，第 3 章交出四个算子与一个泛函。故事轨负责让读者看见“处境”，证据轨负责说明“凭什么”。

证据与可复现读数。书里的定量材料都带快照日与等级：PolitiFact 两万一千余条核实记录；四十五部分期方案；十八对语言版本的叙事距离；OEWN 十二万四千余条义项清单；Seshat 三百九十八个古政体的公开编码；一百二十五个国家的历法采纳年份；一百三十三人一次梯度任务测量；eCFR／Federal Register 二百六十六个节级修订间隔。派生读数在 data/derived/，由脚本生成、不手改；原始快照不入版本，账在 data/DATA-LEDGER.md 与 MANIFEST。附录 B 给出十二个读数的文件、字节与哈希，附录 C 给出协议与敏感性，附录 F 给出十八条否证线与二十条正文否证条件。

本版校订（V3，2026-11-21）。V3 是结构重构：新增第五部分（18—22 章），把演化动力学从附录抬到正文；不新增第一性原理，不新增 P7。重绘第 1 章图 1.1（五个人、账积到忍受线）；第 2.2 节改写为“六张脸，一条原理”；全部公式改为 MathML 并修复 V1 章号（式 21.x—28.x 归位，补式 6.1）；符号取名去撞名（A/D/T/κ/θ 五组）；第 2 章补 24 件系列接口与 Granovetter／Kuran／Pigou；第 11、12 章 34 个 h4 并入正文粗体引导；正文补 194 处图表编号引用；新增 5 处“热点解剖”。本轮另做一次人物页对齐：目录与正文标题统一为“五个人，五张脸（故事轨）”，页内小节由“四条线”改为“五条线：五个人各停在哪一道工序”，并新增一段衔接，把五个人映射到同一流水线的五个卡点。术语表 123 条、索引 144 条；题记与引文 36 处、部分导语 8 段；图 48、表 192；正文 385,969 汉字（全书 425,900）；印刷版 750 页，阅读版 944 页；EPUB 3、网页版与分章 Markdown 齐备。

诚实纪律。凡查不到公开出处的断言逐条降为情景（附录 F）；第 38 章单列九处空白并分四类（缺数据、缺概念、边界、未验）；每一条结论都带“若看到什么就作废”；数据缺口与“删了什么”记在 data/DATA-LEDGER.md；本书没有预注册，三次事先写了判据的检验单列（附录 B.2），其余读数只称读数。

边界。它不主张新第一性（是 Shannon 1948 与 Sims 2003 的应用，加上演化动力学的形式化），不主张人群参数、因果方向、全球普适或政策可操作性。四层与重整化流的关系是形式类比；社会与文明两层是结构慢通、时刻开环。最薄的一层是“谁在选”：模型能说方向与位置，说不出“为什么是这个人、这一年”。

交付包。印刷版 PDF（A4，750 页，含封面与四级书签）、电子阅读版 PDF（重排，944 页）、EPUB 3（nav＋NCX）、网页版 HTML、Markdown（单文件＋56 个分章文件）、可视化包（48 图与八张部分扉页图）、MANIFEST 与 SHA256SUMS。正文与图表 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

版本与系列。2026-11-21；版本 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24413735；概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24339909 不变；上一版 10.5281/zenodo.24393431（642 页），首版 10.5281/zenodo.24390257。数据快照：统计类 2026-11-15/16，新闻类 2026-11-16，文献类 2026-11-19，A 股窗口 2026-10-20 至 11-20。本系列九本书＋十五篇工作论文＋一部合集，共用同一母题：复杂系统如何保持结构、如何变化、如何生成新结构。本书是系列之外的第十册，尚未并入合集，也不计入二十四件；件数以 inventory.tsv 为准。

Abstract.The same effort, spent two ways, yields two different results. Under time pressure, sleep debt and heavy consequences, people do not become lazy: they reallocate a finite bit budget. When the environment is wide they shrink the support and keep a single tunnel; when it is narrow they shrink the resolution and everything blurs. The book starts from one stationarity condition - minimising weighted distortion plus rate cost, v*=(T+λ)/(2w) - and carries it through four layers: person, group, society, civilisation. The layers are not a ladder but a graph with loops: upward, slow variables enter fast layers as parameters (emergence); downward, thresholds rewrite the feasible set of the slow layer (reset). Eight parts, thirty-eight chapters, from a family dinner argument about abandoning an agent to the question of where the book stops. It offers derivations and reproducible readings: 21,063 verification records, 45 periodisation schemes, 18 language-pair narrative distances, 124,147 sense entries, 398 polities, 125 calendars, a 133-person gradient measurement, and 266 section-level revision intervals. Every number is graded A/B/C; no conclusion outruns its evidence.

Central claim.A rule is a partition of a state space; understanding is estimating that partition; a resolution sits at the stationarity point between the cost of error and the price of fineness. From this: doubling coverage halves precision (δ=Δ/2^R); writing the cost of cut points into the ledger gives two scaling laws (a tenfold stake buys the square root or cube root of ten classes); recoding costs once each way, hence asymmetry (bandwidth = 2C). The book has two principles plus one dynamics plus one boundary: (i) partition minimisation under a budget; (ii) the ledger can be externalised and weights can be negative; the dynamics is replicator-mutation-retention plus niche construction (§A.12); the boundary is that exogenous shocks enter only through interfaces and their timing is unpredictable (§A.11). P1-P6 are retrieval labels only, read as two principles plus four interfaces: price, cut, group, ledger. Appendix A maps which conclusion depends on which assumption (Table A.1).

Structure.Eight parts, thirty-eight chapters: I Stage (1-3), why five people argue at one table; II Person (4-8), what a code is built around; III Two budgets (9-12), what love and curiosity cost in bits; IV Group (13-17), why two people must share one cut; V Evolution (18-22), how variation, selection and fields rewrite the feasible set; VI Society (23-28), what verification, bills, involution, drift and tipping can measure; VII Civilisation (29-34), how transition, periodisation, translation and margins recode; VIII Limits (35-38), where the book stops. Six cores (seeing, remembering, keeping up, choosing, narrating, tipping) each have a chapter and a dedicated device. Appendices: A formalisation and proofs; B data and reproduction (files, bytes, hashes for twelve readings); C protocols and robustness; D falsification ledger (append-only, 16 rows); E tools and checklists; F eighteen falsification lines in the table and twenty in the body.

Story track.A juxtapositional story track runs through the book: Frontinus, Murray, Barnum, Semmelweis and Zamenhof, five people from different centuries, sit at one long table and argue about a deleted machine. Persons, events and words are sourced; the meeting is fiction, in the manner of Lu Xun's old stories told anew. The cast page gives five people, five positions and five price sets, and joins the five lines into five stops on one pipeline: measure, cut and trace, remember, verify, belong. Chapter 1 opens the argument, chapter 2 compresses it into one principle, chapter 3 hands over four operators and one functional. The story track shows the situation; the evidence track says why it should be believed.

Evidence and reproducibility.Quantitative material carries snapshot dates and grades: 21,063 PolitiFact verification records; 45 periodisation schemes; 18 language-pair narrative distances; 124,147 OEWN sense entries; 398 Seshat polities; 125 calendar-adoption years; a 133-person gradient measurement; 266 section-level revision intervals from eCFR/Federal Register. Derived readings live in data/derived/ and are script-generated, never hand-edited; raw snapshots are not versioned and are logged in data/DATA-LEDGER.md and MANIFEST. Appendix B gives files, bytes and hashes for twelve readings; Appendix C gives protocols and sensitivity; Appendix F gives eighteen falsification lines in the table and twenty in the body.

What is new in this version.V3 is a structural rebuild: a new Part V (chapters 18-22) lifts evolutionary dynamics from appendix to body; no new first principle, no P7. Figure 1.1 is redrawn (five people, the bill accumulating to a tolerance line); section 2.2 is rewritten as “six faces, one principle”; all formulae are MathML with the legacy V1 equation numbers corrected (21.x-28.x renumbered, (6.1) added); symbols are named and collisions removed (A/D/T/κ/θ); chapter 2 gains the 24-item series interface and Granovetter/Kuran/Pigou; the 34 h4 headings in chapters 11-12 are folded into bold paragraph leads; 194 in-text table/figure references are added; 5 new hot-case boxes. This revision also aligns the cast page: the table of contents and the chapter title now both read “Five people, five faces (story track)”, the subsection “four lines” becomes “five lines: where each person stops on the pipeline”, and a new bridging paragraph maps the five people onto five stops of one pipeline. Glossary 123 terms, index 144 entries; 36 epigraphs, 8 part images; 48 figures, 192 tables; 385,969 characters of body text (425,900 in the whole book); print edition 750 pages, e-reader 944 pages; EPUB 3, web HTML and chaptered Markdown included.

Honest discipline.Unverifiable claims are demoted to scenarios (Appendix F); Chapter 38 lists nine gaps in four classes (missing data, missing concepts, boundaries, untested); every conclusion carries a refutation line; deleted data are logged in data/DATA-LEDGER.md; the book was not preregistered, and the three checks with pre-written criteria are listed separately (B.2); other readings are called readings only.

Boundaries.No new first principle (an application of Shannon 1948 and Sims 2003, plus a formalisation of evolutionary dynamics); no population parameters, no causal direction, no global universality, no policy prescription. The four layers are a formal analogy to renormalisation, not a theorem; the social and civilisational layers are structurally slow-coupled but open in timing. The weakest layer is the selector: the model gives direction and position, not the person or the year.

Package.Print PDF (A4, 750 pages, cover and four-level bookmarks), e-reader PDF (reflowed, 944 pages), EPUB 3 (nav and NCX), web HTML, Markdown (single file plus 56 chapter files), visuals package (48 figures and 8 part frontispieces), MANIFEST and SHA256SUMS. Text and figures CC BY 4.0; code MIT.

Version and series.2026-11-21; version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24413735; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24339909 unchanged; previous version 10.5281/zenodo.24393431 (642 pages), first edition 10.5281/zenodo.24390257. Data snapshots: statistics 2026-11-15/16, news 2026-11-16, literature 2026-11-19, A-share window 2026-10-20 to 11-20. The series contains nine books, fifteen working papers and one collection, sharing one motif: how complex systems keep structure, change, and generate new structure. This is the tenth volume, outside the registered twenty-four and not in the collection; the count is determined by inventory.tsv alone.
notes: 学术—通俗理论书（双轨：通识读者走正文，同行走附录）。2026-11-21；印刷版 750 页；8 部分 38 章；附录 A–F；192 表 48 图；正文 385,969 汉字。凡不可核断言逐条降为情景（附录 F）；第 38 章单列九处空白；结论强度不超过证据强度。未进 inventory.tsv（系列第十册，作者决定）；2026-11-20 首版 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24390257；本版 V3，版本 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24413735；上一版 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24393431（642 页）。本轮校订：故事轨人物页统一为“五个人，五张脸（故事轨）”，五条线并加一段流水线衔接；全格式重排（印刷版 750 页，阅读版 944 页）。
